lines.text: Jeroboam son of Jehoash reigned in Samaria forty-one years and restored Israel's boundary as Jonah the prophet had spoken.
Azariah became king of Judah at sixteen, reigned fifty-two years, and the LORD afflicted him with blindness until he died.
Zechariah reigned six months before Shallum killed him, and then Menahem killed Shallum and reigned in his place.
When Pul king of Assyria invaded, Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver, collected from the wealthy men of Israel.
Pekah reigned twenty years, Tiglath-pileser captured Galilee and Naphtali, and then Hezekiah son of Elah killed Pekah and reigned.
